## The title bar is gone, and Squachy grew into the space

For eleven releases every screen gave its top sixteen rows to a bar that said `>> SQUACHWATCH <<`. You already know what device you are holding. What that bar actually carried was two buttons, so the two buttons stayed and the decoration went.

Settings is still the top-left corner and rotate is still the top-right, both a quarter larger than before and now floating over the live background instead of sitting on a strip. The touch calibration that used to hide in the middle of the bar moved somewhere you might actually find it: press and hold the middle of the button bar for a second and a half, on any screen.

Then everything else moved into the room that opened up.

### He is about a third bigger

Squachy sizes himself from the space he is given, so the rest of this release is mostly a series of arguments about what that space really is.

The counters moved down to sit with the buttons as one footer. The ALL CLEAR headline came down with them and now sits directly on top of the numbers it labels, rather than floating in the middle of the empty space above them. The speech bubble climbs into the old bar's rows when it can, which meant the sixteen rows it used to reserve underneath were no longer needed.

His shadow came off, and that is what bought most of it. It sat at 82 percent of his height, which is exactly where a headline pinned above the counters wants to be, so the two had been fighting over the same rows at every size — a test render put twenty-one of the shadow's pixels in the clear. It reserved fifteen of his sixty-eight base units for something nobody could see, and with it gone those units are his.

The last of it came off his silhouette. His raised waving hand reaches higher than his head does, and reserving space for it cost real size to protect a few rows of a gesture, so the hand is allowed to run off the top now. His head is not.

### The sagittal crest is a cowlick

The pronounced skull peak of every bigfoot sighting is the better reference and was the wrong shape. A single tall point centred over his face read as a spear tip, and at his new size it was clipping off the top of the screen.

It is two tufts now, a short one and a taller one leaning right, chosen from ten rendered in the emulator. The asymmetry is the whole thing: nothing is centred, and the lean is what stops it reading as a shape and starts it reading as hair that slept funny.

### Every costume now fits itself to the screen

Several of the hats are far taller than he is. The wolf's ears are more than three times his own cowlick, and the unicorn's horn is not far behind.

Each costume declares its reach, and the drop needed to bring it inside a tenth of his height is solved rather than hand-tuned. Ten of the fourteen need nothing; tinfoil, captain and parka shrink about two percent; the unicorn and the wolf pelt about thirteen. Crucially he is anchored at the detection bar and shrinks from the top, so changing costume never makes him hop.

### VAPOR SHAGGY

There is a companion now, and he is not a pet so much as a heckler. He runs in from a random side, jumps onto Squachy's head, says something unkind, and drops off using the same gravity that got him up there.

He is unlocked either by holding CLEAR, alongside every costume, or by catching him honestly: he crosses the FLYING TOASTERS background on his own occasionally, and tapping him as he goes is enough. Once he is yours a PETS row appears in Settings to turn him off.

### The one that will save you a support email

If your board boot-loops with an SD card inserted, that is a known bug and the flasher now says so before you flash. Take the card out and it boots. The serial banner will also tell you why it last restarted, which turns a mystery reboot into a one-word answer at 2,000,000 baud.

### The actually-useful part
- **Added**: VAPOR SHAGGY, an unlockable companion who climbs Squachy and insults him
- **Added**: a PETS row in Settings, visible once he is unlocked
- **Added**: confirmation prompts on RECALIBRATE, RESET STATS, BORING MODE and REPLAY INTRO
- **Added**: the serial boot banner now reports the last reset reason
- **Added**: an SD card warning on the flasher page
- **Changed**: the title bar is gone; Settings and rotate are corner buttons, 25 percent larger
- **Changed**: touch calibration is a long press on the middle of the button bar, on every screen
- **Changed**: Squachy is around a third larger, and each costume scales itself to fit
- **Changed**: the crest is a cowlick; the VOID EYE sphere is 14 percent larger
- **Changed**: counters and buttons read as one footer, with the status headline sitting on them
- **Changed**: settings options each sit on their own panel, so the background no longer shows through the lettering
- **Changed**: BACKGROUND and OUTFIT are two-line rows, so long names stop being cut off
- **Fixed**: tapping the moon on the FIRE background rotated the screen instead of summoning anything
- **Fixed**: the pet stood inside Squachy's head rather than on it, and sank independently of his bob
- **Fixed**: the yeti could catch a skier while hidden behind Squachy, so the payoff happened off-screen
- **Fixed**: a strip above the button bar was painted once at boot and never animated again
- **Fixed**: SNOWFALL, FIREFLIES and THE GIBSON ended their ground early and sat on a black shelf
- **Fixed**: six screens started their background below the old title bar, leaving a dead strip
- **Fixed**: a tap on the first counter line registered as a tap on Squachy
- **Fixed**: speech bubbles no longer touch the top edge of the screen
